description: This file contains unit tests for WebSocket text communication within the Thunder project, including classes for WebSocket server and client simulations, and a test case that verifies message exchange over WebSocket.

classes.name: TextSocketServer
classes.description: A mock WebSocket server class for testing WebSocket server behavior.

classes.name: TextSocketClient
classes.description: A mock WebSocket client class for testing WebSocket client behavior.

methods.name: StateChange
methods.description: Handles state change events for the WebSocket server, signals when the server is open.

methods.name: Received
methods.description: Handles incoming messages for the WebSocket server or client.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Placeholder for sending messages over WebSocket, not implemented in tests.

methods.name: GetState
methods.description: Returns whether the WebSocket server has reached the open state.

methods.name: Wait
methods.description: Blocks until the client has received data.

methods.name: Retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves the received message from the client.
